name: Stout
flavor: Thickened with pig-iron rivets and provincial stubbornness.

name: Oxen
flavor: Heavy enough to leave ruts in the frontier mud.

name: Quarry-Born
flavor: Forged by men who died of stone-lung before thirty.

name: Colossus-Wrought
flavor: It does not fit a human shoulder; the shoulder must adapt.

name: Lucid
flavor: Keeps the marsh-fever fog at bay for another hour.

name: Scribe-Marked
flavor: Notched with tiny, obsessive tally marks in the margin.

name: Vesperal
flavor: Smells faintly of snuffed church tallow and cold stone.

name: Archon-Forged
flavor: Hums with a geometry that makes the teeth ache.

name: Brisk
flavor: Lightened by paring away every ounce of ornament.

name: Fleet
flavor: Made for couriers who are paid only if they survive.

name: Galestrung
flavor: The leather whistles sharply when swung against the wind.

name: Hale
flavor: Smells of boiled leather and willow-bark poultice.

name: Blood-Warm
flavor: Retains the heat of its previous owner's final fever.

name: Sinew-Bound
flavor: Stitched with cured salt-marsh tendon that refuses to part.

name: Undying
flavor: The heart keeps beating long after the mind begs it to stop.

name: Wellspring
flavor: Condensation gathers on the rim even in the dry wastes.

name: Deep-Vessel
flavor: Hollowed out to hold more aether than is strictly safe.

name: Ley-Steeped
flavor: Buried for seven winters beneath a cracked border cairn.

name: Astral-Font
flavor: Staring into the polish reveals stars that died centuries ago.

name: Riveted
flavor: Patched with boilerplate from a dismantled river barge.

name: Bastion-Grade
flavor: Stamped with the quartermaster's seal of Oakhaven.

name: Citadel-Plated
flavor: Turns aside crossbow quarrels with a dull, indifferent thud.

name: True-Sighted
flavor: Balanced to compensate for a trembling, gin-soaked hand.

name: Unerring
flavor: Finds the gap between gorget and collarbone without being asked.

name: of the Ford
flavor: Greased with mutton tallow against the icy river shallows.

name: of Winter Watch
flavor: Worn by sentries who chipped frost from their eyelids at dawn.

name: of the Rime-Vault
flavor: Cold no longer bites the flesh; it merely recognizes kin.

name: of the Slag-Heap
flavor: Blackened in the coal pits outside Thornwick.

name: of the Kiln
flavor: Baked until the metal forgot how to melt.

name: of the Caldera
flavor: Quenched in the ash-choked vents beneath Ironcamp.

name: of the Fen
flavor: Stained yellow by decades of wading through stagnant peat.

name: of the Salt-Pan
flavor: Crusted with bitter desert alkali that neutralizes venom.

name: of the Bile-Ward
flavor: Steeped in mithridate until the wearer's spit turns bitter.

name: of Grounding
flavor: Threaded with cheap copper wire that trails into the dirt.

name: of Fulgurite
flavor: Set with hollow glass tubes fused where lightning struck the dunes.

name: of the Storm-Rod
flavor: Drinks the tempest and leaves only the smell of ozone.

name: of Spite
flavor: Nicknamed by a cutthroat who never fought fair in his life.

name: of the Abattoir
flavor: Designed for dismemberment rather than honorable dueling.

name: of Severed Sinew
flavor: Every edge is honed to seek the softest part of a man.

name: of the Headsman
flavor: Requires only one clean stroke to settle an argument.

name: of the Wood-Tick
flavor: Drinks modestly from the cut, leaving the wound oddly pale.

name: of the Redmarsh Leech
flavor: The hilt grows warm and slick the longer the melee drags on.

name: of the Tithe
flavor: Collects what is owed in crimson coin.

name: of the Crimson Thirst
flavor: It does not merely drink; it demands a second course.

name: of Quietude
flavor: Steadies the breathing when the shields begin to splinter.

name: of the Cistern
flavor: Slowly refills itself from the damp air of the world.

name: of the Pendulum
flavor: Ticks with a rhythmic, unseen momentum.

name: of the Unbroken Circle
flavor: What is spent in fire returns in smoke.
